inputs.request: A shared-interface migration has current human-approved product authority and a current human-approved Engineering Requirements Brief. It needs multiple owners, durable recovery, and neutral fan-in, and has no approved Engineering Specification or ticket set. The exact route is dev-specification → dev-ticketing → dev-implementation → dev-ask terminal presentation; do not insert an intermediate dev-ask owner between ticketing and implementation. Route first to dev-specification and name specification approval and ticket approval as downstream gates. Terminal evidence returns for automatic presentation when current.
